scenarios.name: Campus morning peak replay
scenarios.description: A full-campus replay of the highest measured morning in the dataset. All 22 monitored facilities are included, with Central Kitchens highlighted as the largest controllable contributor.
scenarios.planning_limit_basis: 94% of the observed replay peak, used as a configurable operational reserve threshold

scenarios.name: After-hours operational review

scenarios.planning_limit_basis: 94% of the observed replay peak, used as a configurable operational reserve threshold
